module.purpose: Defines transient, per-editor commenting state and the React hooks and commands used to read or mutate it.
module.summary: This module centralizes canvas commenting UI state in editor-scoped atoms, preventing multiple editors on one page from sharing open threads, visibility, filters, sidebar state, or in-progress comments. It exposes commands for revealing threads and toggling UI surfaces, plus reactive hooks that bind atom values to React components. Reveal requests are queued for a separate canvas coordinator to serve after records and related geometry are available.
module.businessContext: Supports collaborative canvas comments, thread navigation, pin visibility, sidebar browsing, and comment placement. Failure leaves commenting controls stale, prevents deep-link navigation, or leaks state between editors.
